title: Live check on NERV-01: the escapes the review found leave nothing running
goal: With _nervjob set up, a quick exit after detaching a child and a double fork after setsid leave no process of _nervjob after the job
acceptance: On NERV-01, both escape jobs end with `ps -U _nervjob` empty and the receipt not uncertain; the commands and output are recorded on B-099
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: A survivor after kill -1 is a finding, recorded, not retried away

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-20 from 0.5 h to 1.5 h (work-items calibrate since 2026-11-15: median 1.0 over 53 steps, but real-device runs took 1.5–3 h): a live check on NERV-01, like F-005-T22 (1.5 h against 0.5 h).
